text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Golshi-san and the others invited me. It's 
a good chance to observe their movements 
up close, isn't it? Of course... if I'm 
doing this, I fully intend to win!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Big sis is pitcher, and I'm shortstop! We 
want Cheval-chi to be our catcher!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
!? N-No way. Being the keystone of the 
fan...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Why, why? When we did it before, 
Cheval-chi, you did super awesome!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Vivlos and the others were the ones who 
really shined. Stopping stolen bases, 
getting strikeouts... So even if it's just 
the two of them...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
No. It went well because your signs were 
so good.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Totally~~! When we stopped those base 
steals, you threw balls that were super 
easy for me to catch!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
The pitch sequence was planned with my 
shoulder in mind, too. That's why I was 
able to pitch all the way to the end. And 
besides...

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
"—It's way more fun with three of us! 
—It's definitely more fun with three of 
us!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Let me think about it for a bit...
